## A table with a row span and no widths

::: {#tbl-html .wrap-right width="45%"}

```{.html-table}
<table>
<tr><th>Group</th><th>Note</th></tr>
<tr><td rowspan="2">one</td><td>short</td></tr>
<tr><td>averyveryverylongwordincolB</td></tr>
</table>
```

A table that Pandoc's HTML reader makes, with a row span.
